title: Jspreadsheet Demo Supply Chain
keywords: Jspreadsheet, JavaScript data grid, spreadsheet controls, interactive data grid, web-based applications, lightweight, responsive controls, agnostic platform, Angular, React, Vue, spreadsheet-like plugin, documentation, examples, license
description: Visualise logistics metrics, such as lead times and supplier performance, in a dynamic spreadsheet layout. Perfect for operations teams.

# Supply Chain

This demo illustrates a supply chain dashboard on a JavaScript spreadsheet component. It features editable tables and integrated charts for tracking lead times, supplier performance, and logistics trends in real time—ideal for operational workflows within modern web applications.

<br>
